summary: HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund (TE) L.P. reported an unregistered continuous private placement of limited partnership units under Item 3.02, with roughly $1.89 million of Class A and Class I units finalized September 3, 2026, priced off July 31, 2026 Transactional NAVs. The HSEC Fund Complex, including the Fund and a Cayman parallel vehicle feeding HSEC Holdings L.P., issued about $4.9 million of interests. Sales went to accredited investors and qualified purchasers under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or close date; routine capital formation, not a special situation. Watch NAV marks and pace of raises.
